reviews.text:
I first went to this clinic for an emergency; one of my rats was experiencing respiratory distress. Dr. Brahimi took care of her as soon as we arrived and literally saved her life without any complications. Thank you again for this quick and unexpected intervention.

I plan to return to this clinic for my animals' routine checkups instead of going to my usual clinic, which is much further from my home.

The reception was very responsive and accommodating, which allowed my cat to be seen as an emergency very quickly.
Thank you!

Last Saturday, my French bulldog swallowed some chicken bones, and no clinic would help me. The Épinettes clinic took him in between two other emergencies and saved his life.

A huge thank you! 😊🙏

Thank you to all the members of this clinic who have been supporting us and our animals for over four years now.

A special mention to Dr. Brahimi, who recently guided us through the initial stages of grieving the loss of our cat, Scoody. This doctor's immense humanity and kindness are truly remarkable; a huge thank you to him.

Our kitten had health problems from a very young age. Dr. Soler quickly identified the cause of his issues and found solutions! Gentle, attentive, and passionate, she even checks in to see how our kitten is doing. We are so glad she's been a part of our care.
Dr. Soler is very attentive and explains the procedures clearly. A thorough and meticulous check-up for my dog. I highly recommend him!
THANKS

What a wonderful discovery! I made an appointment because slots were available in August, unlike many other vets who are closed until September.

Upon arrival, I was greeted by four adorable young interns, including Sacha and Google, who were very welcoming despite their obviously busy schedules!

The assistant and the vets are very competent, attentive, and truly take the time to listen to the animals and their owners.

After a rather difficult summer with several temperature changes, my cat had caught a cold. Dr. Soler took the time to examine him very gently, explain the situation to me, and answer all my questions.

I trust them completely. The four cats that the clinic welcomes and cares for free are pampered. This speaks volumes about the ethos of this clinic, where the well-being, care, and happiness of the animals are clearly a priority.

A truly wonderful discovery; I recommend this clinic without hesitation!

A truly wonderful experience with this veterinarian. My cat is usually very fearful at the vet, but this time, she was surprisingly relaxed. The vet was incredibly gentle, very attentive, and immediately understood her needs.

The service was very quick and, above all, very reassuring, delivered with great kindness and professionalism. You can really tell that he loves animals and takes the time to put them at ease.

A huge thank you for your kindness and efficiency. I highly recommend him!

Dr. Brahimi is an excellent veterinarian, and I highly recommend him.

I consulted him about my kitten, whom I had just adopted from the shelter.
Sasha was experiencing some issues that had caused her to become incontinent.
After performing the necessary examinations, Dr. Brahimi made a diagnosis.
The diagnosis was correct. Sasha is doing very well, and I thank him for his attentiveness and his evident love for animals.
His three cats are magnificent!
Please note, the price for group cremation of exotic pets is very high: €165, which is double that of some competitors.
The vet is very attentive and friendly.
Dr. Brahimi is always excellent with my dogs.
Thank you so much

I visited this clinic in January and March to get EU pet passports issued.

The veterinarians were different women, and both were kind and thorough in conducting the basic physical examination and document consultation.

My relative is planning to bring their dog to Paris this summer, and I intend to recommend this clinic to them.

Dear Vets, thank you so much for your kindness in sorting out the pet passports for Dalja and Ssamjang.
THANKS

Ulysse has been under Dr. Brahimi's care since he was a puppy. I can only thank him for his diagnosis, which saved my little guy. Following the detection of a foreign body, emergency surgery was performed. He has been recovering peacefully for a week now.

Thank you, Doctor, and your entire team!

Excellent clinic, I highly recommend it, especially Dr. Brahimi who has been treating our puppy since the beginning! Superb follow-up, very available and professional, you can go there with complete confidence!

I am recommending this to everyone visiting Paris who needs to visit a veterinary clinic.

Please make sure to use this clinic.

They are very kind and professional.

I have no other words to express it.

Thank you.

It is the best veterinary clinic.

WARNING NOTE / SERVICE COMPLAINT

I wish to express my dissatisfaction with the service I recently received at this pet shop/veterinary clinic. Unfortunately, my experiences with some of the staff, particularly at reception, have been negative. On several occasions, the reception was curt, unfriendly, and sometimes gave the impression of a lack of patience and willingness to help—both on the phone and in person.

Furthermore, during a consultation, I observed one of the veterinarians handling the animals somewhat roughly, which concerned me as a pet owner. I believe this type of situation warrants special attention so that clients can feel safe and confident when bringing their pets in.

I would like to acknowledge that there is a very kind and professional veterinarian, Dr. Louise, and I am grateful to her. However, the behavior of the rest of the staff detracts from the overall experience. It's the veterinarians in the back who end up suffering, as they're often unaware of how clients are treated at reception.

This saddens me, as this clinic is close to my home and I would have liked to continue going there. However, due to the treatment I received, I've decided not to return. I strongly recommend that the team improve its customer service; otherwise, many clients are likely to stop going to the clinic.

The worst thing about this clinic is that they want to argue with clients in the reviews. It's not just one or two negative comments, it's several. And they still want to argue with clients here, in the comments.

Be professional and learn to work with the public; clients always have their reasons!
First visit. Very friendly vet who doesn't push you to buy unnecessary products...
Thank you so much for your encouragement. See you soon.

Amazing! Incredibly kind. They are true animal lovers who are deeply committed to the well-being of the animals. I won't go into details, but I am extremely touched by everything they did for Pita, our little puppy who was lost and whom they rescued. Thank you, thank you, and thank you again!!!

We brought our cat in for a tooth extraction and we are very satisfied. The vet is both highly competent and truly passionate about animals. You can tell he takes his time, explains things well, and is very gentle. The practice has a warm atmosphere: several rescued cats live there and roam freely, which reflects his love for animals. We highly recommend this vet!

I've been going to this clinic for about three years with my two cats. Dr. Brahimi is efficient, gentle with animals, and offers sound advice. He notably helped us manage the cancer one of our cats was suffering from. I highly recommend this clinic to all my contacts in Paris. The rest of the staff is always excellent, although sometimes the reception staff might be asleep when you arrive (see photo)!
Thank you so much

Hello,
I can't find your name in our customer database. I can't respond to your review if you haven't visited us.
Please be honest and explain your dissatisfaction or remove this unfounded review.

Thank you

A very bad experience. My dog ​​is naturally a bit stressed at the vet, which isn't unusual, and I was expecting at least a minimum of understanding and calm from the professional. Unfortunately, the vet I saw was anything but reassuring: no gentleness, no explanation, and an accusatory tone from the very first minutes.

Not only did he fail to calm my dog, but he also questioned my ability to handle him correctly, as if it were all my fault. This kind of attitude is unacceptable, especially in a profession where empathy should be fundamental.

With this kind of behavior, I don't see how anyone can practice medicine. I will never set foot in that clinic again.

Excellent! Always available for emergencies, he never leaves anyone behind.
My cats are treated by him for thyroid issues.

I've only had to use this clinic twice. The veterinarian, Dr. Brahimi, seems to be a good one.

However, last year my cat had an ultrasound there, and I never received the report by email (the diagnosis was given verbally).

We also had to have him euthanized three weeks ago: I paid €510 for the two injections and the shared cremation (without a consultation). When I mention it to people, everyone tells me that these prices are far from what you'd expect, even in Paris, especially for a shared cremation.
I didn't get a quote; I wasn't going to visit several vets. I simply wanted my cat to pass away peacefully. But still... When they asked me about payment, I paid part by credit card and the rest by check. The check was cashed the same day. Double whammy. I won't be going back.
Excellent veterinary clinic.
I had a very good experience there, I recommend it.
Such a review without any explanation, without justification for your visit to us, has no value and shows the courage of the person who posts it.

We initially came for an emergency, but Dr. Brahimi and his colleagues took excellent care of our rabbit. We returned to have our female rabbit spayed and received very good service. We will definitely be back for regular care.

Thank you!

I highly recommend them.

The clinic is clean.
The vet is really great.

Many thanks to the entire team at the Batignolles clinic.
All the staff demonstrate remarkable compassion, and their love for animals is immediately apparent.

Dr. Brahimi provides highly professional care for Tatoum, my 15-year-old cat. She has been by my side for many years without any health problems before the signs of old age began to disrupt our daily lives. Wanting to offer Tatoum the best possible care and quality of life, I didn't hesitate to contact Dr. Brahimi, an excellent veterinarian.

Thank you for your support; Tatoum is so precious to me.

AM

Excellent veterinary clinic with Dr. Brahimi.

He took care of our two kittens with great care and kindness.

The team is professional and very pleasant.

I highly recommend this clinic.
Thank you for your encouragement!

I got my little Yoda from them. Clean, great service, and the doctors are amazing with little ones!

A little shout-out to Dr. Brahimi's sublime Star Wars collection.

I am so grateful for Dr. Brahimi's dedication and that of the entire team. Beyond their kindness, empathy, and attentiveness, professionalism remains paramount. Dr. Brahimi is a truly generous person, both personally and professionally. I know everyone is doing everything in their power for my dear Luka. I want to thank you all warmly for your invaluable help during his visits. Thank you all!
Thank you so much for your encouragement! See you soon!
Thank you so much
Thank you so much
A very competent and empathetic veterinarian who prioritizes the well-being of our furry friends.
Dr. Brahimi was very understanding and professional. Thanks again :)
I strongly advise against going there. They are very shady, I don't know, never leave your pet alone with them, they are unprofessional, be careful, I will never bring my dog ​​back to you.
Great team, very attentive
Quick and efficient. A bit pricey, but that's to be expected in Paris.
